lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Excuse me, but is this Commander {AccountData.NickName}?
Yes.
No.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Phew, good.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Sorry!
Just kidding :D

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Aw man, you got me good, Master!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I thought for sure I'd texted the wrong person.
What's up?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: We're going to be working together, and

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I just wanted to introduce myself.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: My name's Soda. I'm responsible for all the cooking and cleaning in Maid For You.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Text me whenever you need anything.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I also give great massages, and I'm able to clean your ears as well if you need that.
Actually, now that you mention it...

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Yes?
My neck has been killing me lately. I could use a massage.
My ears have been super itchy lately. I could use an ear cleaning.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Ah, gotcha.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Well, whenever you're free,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: stop by the Maid Cafe.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'll have you feeling better in no time.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I can also come to you if that's more convenient.
Great, thanks.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I should get back to cleaning.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: See you around!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Looking forward to working with you.
